newsitem.title: UK: BFI down seven as Panamaxes continue to soften.
newsitem.headline: BFI down seven as Panamaxes continue to soften.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was down seven to 1,287 points with Panamax rates contuing to drift in most areas.
The only exception appeared to be USGulf to Japan where brokers noted a marginal improvement and raised the rate from $22.375 to $22.45 with combination.
The falling South American market was represented by Finagrains' fixture of Giuseppe D'Amato for 55,000 dwt grains 53 ft Brazil to Kosichang for mid-Aug at $21.75 basis two to one.
The Baltic Handy Index was also easier, down five to 993 points.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was 17 points higher to two points lower and turnover was 145 lots.
